Garage Doors in St. Louis, MO
Professional Garage Door Services in St. Louis, Missouri

Your home deserves more than just any garage door. Whether you're upgrading your current door, adding a new garage, or replacing a worn-out system on your existing home, the quality of that garage door installation determines everything. How long your door lasts. How well it protects your vehicles and belongings. How much you spend on energy bills. How your home looks from the street. One professional installation done right protects your family and your investment for decades. One careless installation creates problems you'll fight for years.

When you're ready to install a new garage door, you face dozens of decisions that seem overwhelming. Which materials actually perform well in St. Louis's climate? How much insulation does your garage really need? What opener provides real reliability? Should you upgrade to smart technology? Do you need weather sealing, and if so, what type? These aren't just technical details. They're the difference between a garage door that performs beautifully for 20 years and one that fails in year five.
Why St. Louis Homeowners Need Reliable Garage Door Services

Here's what separates professional garage door work from amateur installations. The materials themselves are only half the equation. How those materials get installed matters just as much as which brand you choose. We've replaced countless garage doors that used premium panels but failed early because someone rushed the installation, skipped critical steps, or didn't understand proper spring tension and track alignment.

St. Louis's weather demands more from your garage door than most people realize. Spring thunderstorms test every seal's weather resistance. Summer humidity cycles expand and contract materials hundreds of times. Fall temperature swings challenge every spring's tension calibration. Winter ice and snow push against bottom seals where poor installation leaves gaps. Your garage door needs to handle all of this, year after year, without compromise.

Picture this common scenario. You hired the lowest bidder to install your new garage door last year. Everything looked fine when they finished. But now you're noticing problems. Strange grinding noises when the door operates. Gaps along the bottom letting cold air and pests inside. The opener struggling on humid days. Springs that seem to be losing tension faster than they should. Your beautiful new garage door is failing, and the company that installed it stopped returning your calls months ago.

Poor installation doesn't announce itself with obvious signs on day one. It reveals itself slowly through premature failure, costly repairs, and endless frustration. By the time you realize something's wrong, your warranty claims get denied because "improper installation voids coverage." You're stuck paying twice for the same garage door.
St. Louis's Most Trusted Garage Door Services

Coldstream Exteriors has spent over 25 years installing garage doors that perform exactly as they should. We specialize in professional garage door services that solve problems before they start instead of creating issues you'll fight later. We're not here to rush through your project and move to the next job. We're here to give you a properly installed garage door with quality materials, experienced installation crews, and guarantees that actually mean something.
Garage Doors Installation

New construction, home additions, or upgrading from an outdated manual door—our garage door installation team handles every project with precision. We assess your garage opening dimensions, recommend the right door style and materials for your home's architecture, and install everything according to manufacturer specifications. From single-car residential garages to oversized three-car installations, we deliver results that look great and function flawlessly for decades.
Garage Doors Replacement

When repair costs exceed replacement value or your current door no longer meets your needs, complete garage door replacement makes sense. We remove your existing door, dispose of old materials responsibly, and install your new system from tracks to opener. Replacement projects often include upgrading insulation values, improving weather sealing, adding smart opener technology, and enhancing curb appeal with modern panel designs.

Many St. Louis homeowners come to us with different garage door needs. Maybe you're finishing that detached garage you've been planning for years. Maybe you're building a new home and want the garage door done right from day one. Maybe you're adding a workshop or studio and need seamless integration with your property. Maybe your current garage door is beyond repair and needs complete tear-out and reinstallation.

Here's exactly what happens. Call us for a free consultation and we'll come to your property within 24 hours to assess your project properly. Frequently Asked Questions About Garage Doors in St. Louis
How much does garage door installation cost in St. Louis?

Most St. Louis garage door installations range from $800 to $3,500, depending on door size, material choice, and opener features. A typical single-car steel door with standard opener averages $1,200-$1,800. Two-car doors typically cost $1,800-$2,800. Premium insulated doors or carriage-house styles can reach $3,500-$5,000. We provide detailed written estimates after your free consultation, and you pay nothing until installation is 100% complete.
How long does garage door installation take in St. Louis?

Most residential garage door installations take 3-6 hours with our experienced crews. Simple single-car replacements can often be completed in 3-4 hours, while complex multi-car installations with opener upgrades typically take 5-6 hours. New construction timelines coordinate with your builder's schedule. Weather conditions rarely affect garage door installation timelines.
What garage door materials do you recommend for St. Louis homes?

Steel garage doors are most popular for St. Louis homes, offering excellent durability, low maintenance, and good insulation options at reasonable prices. Aluminum doors provide lightweight operation and modern aesthetics. Wood and composite doors deliver classic carriage-house style but require more maintenance. During your consultation, we show you samples and explain which materials work best for your home and budget.
Do you handle garage door installation for new construction projects?

Yes, we work with homeowners, builders, and contractors on new construction garage door installation throughout St. Louis. We coordinate with your construction timeline, deliver materials on schedule, and install your garage door system according to code requirements and manufacturer specifications.
Can you install a new garage door on my existing opening?

Most existing garage openings accept new door installations without modification. We measure your opening precisely, assess header support and track clearance, and recommend doors sized for your space. Occasionally older openings need minor framing adjustments. We identify any modifications during your free consultation and include them in your estimate.
What makes Coldstream Exteriors different from other St. Louis garage door companies?

You pay nothing until your garage door installation is 100% complete and you're satisfied. No deposit, no progress payments, no financial risk. We've earned our BBB A+ rating and 4.9 stars from 400+ customers by treating St. Louis homeowners right for over 25 years.
How do I prepare my garage for door installation?

We handle most preparation, but homeowners should clear items within 4 feet of the garage door opening, move vehicles out of the garage and driveway, ensure electrical outlets are accessible for opener installation, and keep children and pets away from the work area during installation. We'll provide a complete preparation checklist before we start.
